summary: The table titled 'Financial Performance Summary' presents a comparative analysis of key financial metrics for the periods ending June 30, 2025, June 30, 2024, and March 31, 2025. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, along with growth percentages year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ). Notable insights include a 7.5% YoY growth in revenues from June 2024 to June 2025 and a 3.3% QoQ increase by March 2025. Operating expenses and net profit also show significant growth, with operating profit increasing by 6.2% YoY. The table highlights financial performance trends and provides a detailed breakdown of earnings per share (EPS) and dividend per share metrics.
